model_packet.record_rule: Every observed or unresolved record has an integer score in {-1, 0, 1}. Observed records reveal their scores. A finite unresolved count means each unresolved score may independently take any allowed value. An unbounded unresolved count means no finite lower or upper completion total is established.
model_packet.selection_rule: Choose the strongest claim guaranteed across every completion allowed by the stated unresolved-evidence bound. Weaken a directional claim only when an allowed completion can make the complete-universe total non-directional or reverse it.
